instruction: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.

arguments.hindsight: I should have secured the upright holder with a low side grasp from the start, verified a reachable tip-up pen pose in clear space, and used smaller alignment corrections before approaching the rim.
arguments.reason: I could not reliably align and insert the pens. Repeated pose shortfalls and arm interference disrupted the holder and the pen grasp.
